name: derivative
description: A native macOS browser, powered by Chromium.
author: A Browser Guy

scripts.test: npm run test:state && npm run test:engine && npm run test:keychain && npm run test:favicons
scripts.test:keychain: mkdir -p native/build && xcrun clang++ -std=c++20 -fobjc-arc native/Tests/KeychainTests.mm -framework Foundation -framework Security -o native/build/keychain-tests && native/build/keychain-tests
scripts.test:state: mkdir -p native/build && xcrun swiftc -swift-version 5 -module-cache-path native/.cache/swift-modules native/Sources/BrowserState.swift native/Sources/Organization.swift native/Sources/FavoriteLayout.swift native/Tests/StateTests.swift -o native/build/state-tests && native/build/state-tests
scripts.test:integration: node native/scripts/verify.mjs && node native/scripts/tabs-profiles.mjs && node native/scripts/sidebar-layout.mjs && node native/scripts/sidebar-animation.mjs && node native/scripts/features.mjs && node native/scripts/context-menu.mjs && node native/scripts/media.mjs
